tools.name: list_programmes
tools.description: List the fee-bearing, credit-bearing university programmes (degrees and postgraduate diplomas) awarded by Mind Power University and delivered by Sportal Corporate. Returns the fee, duration, credential and the marketing page carrying eligibility and intake dates. Use this for questions about degrees

tools.name: list_free_courses
tools.description: List the free, self-paced short courses. These are NOT university qualifications and carry no academic credit; most end in a quiz that issues a QR-verifiable certificate. Optionally filter by subject group.

tools.name: get_course
tools.description: Get one course or programme in full by its slug, including its module or lesson outline. Slugs come from list_programmes, list_free_courses or search_courses.

tools.name: calculate_total_annual_fee
tools.description: Compute what one year at the Sportal IMPACT Campus actually costs, in INR: tuition for a named programme, plus optional hostel (accommodation, food and laundry), plus the one-time charges that apply in the first year only. Use this instead of adding the published figures yourself — the first year co

tools.name: get_admission_dates
tools.description: When admissions open and teaching begins. Returns the academic session, whether applications are currently open, and whether an entrance exam is required. No application deadline is published and the seat count is deliberately unpublished — the response says so explicitly rather than omitting them,

tools.name: check_eligibility
tools.description: Check whether a student meets the published entry requirement for a programme, given their Class 12 percentage or highest qualification. tools.name: search_courses
tools.description: Search every public course and programme by name and description. Use when the subject is known but the slug is not — for example 'sports analytics' or 'nutrition'.
